newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says economy grew 7.82 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says economy grew 7.82 pct in 1996.

text.p: The minister for national development planning and head of the state planning board, Ginanjar Kartasasmita, said on Thursday Indonesia's economy grew by 7.82 percent in calendar 1996, against a revised 8.21 percent in 1995.
"The growth of 7.82 percent is satisfying," Kartasasmita told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
He said economic growth in 1995 had been revised up to 8.21 percent from 8.1 percent, but did not give any reason.

Kartasasmita said that in 1996, the processing industry grew by 11.03 percent; electricity, gas and clean water rose 12.61 percent; building materials grew by 12.37 percent; financial and corporate services were up 10.52 percent.
He said the trade, hotel and restaurant sector grew by 7.63 percent, mining by 7.13 percent while agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry and forestry grew by 1.89 percent.
